messages:
auditor_jane: Hi all, ISO/SOC2 fieldwork starting Mon. Auditor request: we need a mapping from each incident response playbook step to concrete artifacts (RBAC change logs, KMS usage/rotation events, SIEM detection queries, vuln triage tickets with remediation evidence, and custody metadata for exported evidence). Also need one sanitized incident package that followed the playbook. Who can own this and what's ETA?

maria: I can drive. Clarify scope: full retrospective mapping for last 12 months or a generic crosswalk + one recent example?

auditor_jane: Crosswalk + one recent example (any sev2 or higher). Crosswalk should reference storage paths and reproduction commands. Example exports must be redacted but reproducible.

kevin: For RBAC we keep k8s audit exporter snapshots and a daily IAM snapshot for cloud accounts. We can produce: - rolebinding snapshots (k8s) - AWS/IAM policy change history CSV - GCP audit log extracts for iam.* events. Repro command: `gcloud logging read 'protoPayload.methodName:roles.setIamPolicy' --freshness=48h`

samir: KMS side: CloudTrail/Stackdriver capture Encrypt/Decrypt/GenerateDataKey and RotateKey. We'll pull keyMetadata and eventIDs. We tag emergency key uses with `emergency=true` in encryptionContext; query filters include that. Example CloudTrail CLI: `aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=Encrypt --start-time 2026-03-01T00:00:00Z --end-time 2026-03-10T00:00:00Z`

irene: For vuln triage evidence we'll export the Jira ticket export (CSV) for the triage workflow and link to PRs/commits that remediate. We'll include CVE references (if any), patch PR IDs, and deployment rollout tags.

maria: Proposed deliverables: 1) crosswalk.md (matrix: playbook step -> artifact type -> path & sample filename) 2) reproducible export scripts (sh) 3) exemplar incident bundle (sanitized) with timeline.txt, screenshots, RBAC diffs, CloudTrail KMS excerpts, Jira CSV, SIEM saved-search JSON 4) chain_of_custody.md with checksums/gpg sigs + who exported. We'll aim to have draft crosswalk + scripts in 24 hours. Example bundle in 72 hours.

auditor_jane: Please also include mapping to ISO/ SOC controls (e.g., ISO 27001 A.16.1 -> incident timeline, SOC2 CC6.1 -> log integrity). That helps the auditor reviewers.

kevin: Will annotate each crosswalk row with control IDs. Also note: RBAC temporary escalation proof requires approval ticket + deprovision audit. We have an automation that reverts rolebindings after TTL; I'll include the automation run logs.

samir: Emergency KMS access: we maintain an emergency key access log in CloudTrail and mirror to internal SIEM with field `emergency_approval_ticket`. I'll include a sample event and the exact Splunk query used to extract them. Splunk example: `index=prod_kms eventName=Encrypt encryptionContext.emergency=true | table _time userIdentity arn requestParameters`

irene: Redaction note: anything that contains customer PII will be sanitized using `scripts/redact-logs.py` which replaces user payload fields with `<REDACTED>` and preserves schema. We'll include the script plus the verification checksum of originals in a confidential bucket.

maria: Chain-of-custody pattern: exporter name/email, host (ops-host-01.redwood.company), UTC timestamps, sha256 of each artifact, gpg detached signature, S3 path (presigned), TTL, and security reviewer sign-off. We'll add a short template COC entry to crosswalk.md.

auditor_jane: Good. Two detail asks: (1) show the RBAC git diff workflow (commands + sample diff) and (2) provide a short note on key rotation policy and proof that rotate events ran as scheduled for the example key.

kevin: RBAC git diff workflow snippet we'll include: ```bash
git clone ssh://git.internal/audit-snapshots.git
git checkout snapshots/2026-03
cp snapshot-2026-03-09/rolebinding-prod.yaml old.yaml
cp snapshot-2026-03-10/rolebinding-prod.yaml new.yaml
git --no-pager diff --no-index old.yaml new.yaml > rbac-diff-2026-03-10.patch
```
I'll attach a sanitized sample diff as rbac-diff-2026-03-10.patch in the bundle.

samir: Rotation policy: keys are on a 365-day rotation schedule unless marked permanent; we log rotate events (`RotateKey`) in CloudTrail. For proof I'll include key metadata CSV: `key_id,arn,created_at,last_rotated_at,status` and a small script to grep rotate events for that key.

maria: SIEM saved searches to include (Datadog/Splunk): - suspicious service account creation - sudden spike in decrypt events - emergency key usage. We'll export saved-search JSON and provide examples.

auditor_jane: Can you also add a short chain-of-custody sentence for each artifact in the crosswalk (who touched it, how it was moved)? Auditors want that in-line.

ops-bot: Presigned export job scheduled: job=job-4801125000-A. ETA ~90 minutes. URL will be posted here when ready.

irene: I'll prepare the redaction checklist (fields to redact, approver list) and include a redaction manifest that shows counts of redacted records per file.

maria: Acceptance criteria to auditors: crosswalk.md + scripts must allow a reviewer to reproduce the artifact exports in their environment (with read-only access). We'll include exact CLI commands, required permissions, and saved-search definitions.

auditor_jane: That should work. Please CC me on the S3 presigned URL and include an escalation contact (phone/email).

maria: Will do. tagging kevin and samir to attach RBAC diffs and KMS excerpts when upload completes.

kevin: Ack, will upload rbac-diff and snapshot commands.

samir: Ack, will attach CloudTrail excerpts and key CSV.

maria: Timeline recap: draft crosswalk + scripts in 24h; sample sanitized incident bundle in 72h; final signed package with COC within 5 business days.

auditor_jane: Thanks team, appreciate the thorough plan. :thumbsup:
